data.desc: Ultrapar Holdings Inc. is a Brazilian diversified holding company operating across fuel distribution, liquefied petroleum gas (LPG), specialty chemicals, bulk liquid storage, and logistics services. Through its business units, the company supplies fuel and energy products to retail, commercial, and industrial customers while also offering integrated logistics and storage infrastructure. Ultrapar continues to focus on operational efficiency, portfolio optimization, and expanding value-added energy and mobility services across Brazil and Latin America.
